definitions.explanation: A portable telephone. Short for {携帯|けいたい}{電話|でんわ}. One of the most commonly used words in modern Japanese.

examples.japanese: {携帯|けいたい}を{忘|わす}れました。
{携帯|けいたい}の{番号|ばんごう}は{何|なん}ですか。
{携帯|けいたい}で{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}りました。
examples.english: I took a photo with my phone.

notes: Short for {携帯|けいたい}{電話|でんわ}. Also commonly called スマホ (smartphone) in modern usage. {携帯|けいたい} literally means 'portable' but is almost always understood to mean 'mobile phone' in daily conversation.
